hooks.name: Guard shell commands

action.command: node -e "import(require('url').pathToFileURL(require('path').resolve(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||'','_ai/hooks/guard.mjs')).href).then(m=>m.run(),e=>{console.error('Blocked: the guard hook could not load ('+e.message+'). Fix _ai/hooks/guard.mjs.');process.exit(2)})"
